messages.name: ERCOT
messages.title: Non-Spin deployed
messages.text: ERCOT deployed Non-Spin at 100% of awards from 17:36 to 19:16.

messages.content: I’ll book morning and evening battery sales, recharge in lower-priced hours, and use the remaining power and stored energy for reserves. I’ll check feasibility before committing, then manage the book through the day’s watches.

The day-ahead book is committed. The morning sale and recharge have run as planned, with no reserve failures so far. Real-time prices fell below zero in hours 9–10; the controller curtailed PV, and the battery is now full for the evening sales.

ERCOT has deployed Non-Spin through 19:16; we have no Non-Spin awards. I’ll retain 10 MWh from the hour-19 sale to give the later reserves and end-of-day target a buffer against lower-than-expected RegDn charging.
